notes.title: Aftershocks Quickstart Feature Arrives + Patch Notes and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[u][b]Patch Notes - 10/13/2021[/b][/u]
Improvements and fixes arrive!

We've fixed major progress blockers and other inconveniences, but if you still have issues you need addressed, please continue to reach out to us in the steam community pages and also on our Discord: https://discord.gg/skydanceinteractive

[b]Additions/Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Quickstart for Aftershocks is now available! It allows direct access to the free Aftershocks post-game content.
[*] Vive Controls for the UV Flashlight has been updated: the player can now double tap “down” on either trackpad to activate the UV Flashlight
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the radio could stutter or play the incorrect lines when first starting the Aftershocks content from a post-game save
[*] Fixed an issue where if the player never picked up a key for Aftershocks and left the map, it would not respawn
[*] Distant gun fire should no longer sound like it’s in the player’s ear
[*] Impact sounds should play again
[*] Invincible Collapsed Walkers / Toe Piranhas / Demon Logs should now be extinct
[*] Player should now be able to exit the credits early
[*] Fall Knife Giveaway has ended.  Thank you all for your participation and support!
[/list]

notes.title: New Release Date for Aftershocks + FAQ!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=djufjNlSABw;full][/previewyoutube]
Thanks for your patience, Tourists.

We know that delays are always tough. For our first simultaneous cross-platform content release, the team has been working hard at getting all versions of the update to live up to our standards.

The good news is that we have a new launch date for [i]Aftershocks[/i], [b]September 23rd! [/b] 

The content itself is playable and practically complete, but we are trying to smooth out as many rough edges as we can find. We have been humbled by how many of you have enjoyed the game, and [i]Aftershocks[/i] won’t be the end of the content coming to [i]The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners.[/i] We will reveal more on this in the coming months.

Still, since September is over a month away, and fans are clamoring to know more about [i]Aftershocks[/i], we thought we would provide an FAQ / feature breakdown to hold you over, and help you prepare for the time being. 

- - -

[b]What exactly is the [i]Aftershocks[/i] update?[/b]
[i]Aftershocks[/i] is the next free update for [i]The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners[/i], expanding the campaign of the game with a new set of post-ending missions, supply caches to find, and a new set of challenges to test your survival skills.

[b]Is it coming to all platforms?[/b]
Yes! The [i]Aftershocks[/i] update will be coming the same day to all VR platforms that [i]Saints & Sinners[/i] has been released on. 

[b]How do I play the new content?[/b]
You will have to have reached the ending of the game’s storyline first before the new content unlocks. Once you have officially entered the post-game (i.e. after the credits) keep your radio tuned to channel 47, you may find that it’s worth your while. 

[b]What does the new update include?[/b]
Alongside the new missions, the update includes a number of Reserve Caches to find that are filled with late game supplies and unique collectibles, new enemy layouts and scenarios, a new type of environmental hazard to watch out for, and a few extra surprises you’ll find throughout your playthrough. 

[b]Will there be new areas in [i]Aftershocks[/i]?[/b]
You will be returning to old locations during your time in [i]Aftershocks[/i], but each mission drastically changes, and makes it more challenging, what you’ve grown accustomed to expect. Put simply, the areas are familiar but what you’ll encounter within them won’t be.

[b]Will there be new weapons/items in [i]Aftershocks[/i]?[/b]
While your walker slaying arsenal won’t be drastically changed by this new update, there may be a new tool that will change the way you interact with the world of [i]Saints & Sinners[/i]...beyond that, we can’t say much. 

[b]How Long is the new update?[/b]
On a standard playthrough the update should provide around 4 to 6 hours of new content.

[b]How big will the download for the new update be?[/b]
The download size for the update will depend on which version of the game you are playing, but our current estimations are as follows...
[list]
[*] PCVR - 31.3GB
[*] Oculus Quest 1/2 - 6.73GB
[*] PSVR - 9.67GB
[/list]  
More space may be necessary than listed for the initial download, but the total update after installation will be close to the sizes listed above.

[b]When is the [i]Aftershocks[/i] update even coming out?[/b]
Our new planned release date for the update will be September 23rd, 2021.

notes.title: Get ready for Aftershocks: New campaign content coming to Saints & Sinners!
notes.content:
Your tour through undead New Orleans isn't over just yet. On May 20th jump back on your skiff and return to the deadly world of [i]The Walking Dead[/i] in this free post-campaign adventure, [i][b]Aftershocks.[/b][/i]

Supply caches once thought destroyed by the Tourist’s actions are washing up across the city, and Tower and Reclaimed alike will do everything they can to secure them. If you wish to get your hands on the remnants of the Reserve then you must face off against more dangers, survivors, and walkers than ever before.

New missions, stories, collectibles, and survival tools await you on this dangerous new journey. This is only the start of the threats lurking just below the surface, so stay tuned for more updates in the future. 

Will you be ready to face the aftershocks?

[previewyoutube=oNfyLIguEg8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Check out the trailer today!

- - -

UPDATE: The initial launch date has been delayed. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/916840]Look here for more details. [/url]

notes.title: Release notes for Hotfix #4 - The Walking Dead Saints & Sinners, CL 158675
notes.content:
[b]Release notes for Hotfix #4 - The Walking Dead Saints & Sinners, CL 158675[/b] 

[u][b]Additions/Improvements:[/b][/u][list][*]Alpha SteamVR Oculus Support (ini change is required, see the “Hacks” section below)[list][*]This is an early Work-in-Progress version and there may be some flaws. However, after our initial tests we thought we could share it with now and ask for your help to improve it. Your feedback is always welcomed and is extremely helpful![/list]
[*]Previously unavailable recipes now have a chance to drop from Elite Soldiers during the post game
[*]Increased the Save Slots from 6 to 15 [/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u][list][*] Event System should now continue after completing the game[list][*]***Note*** We miscommunicated this release note, and we apologize for that! The Event System will work properly for any new game or if it wasn't already broken. If you already have this issue, it will not be fixed. We are looking into a retroactive fix and will keep you posted![/list]
[*]Progression Break - Retroactive fix for “Tomb and the Tower V” (May Intel Quest)[list][*]If you were already previously stuck on this quest, this should allow you to continue[/list][/list]
 
[u][b]Hacks:[/b][/u][list][*]To enable Alpha SteamVR Oculus support[list][*]After downloading the patch, run the game and then exit again
[*]Open your GameUserSettings.ini
[*]Find the block of settings beneath the line [b](/Script/TWD.TWDGameUserSettings)[/b]
[*]Find the entry [b]bEnableOculusSteamVR=False[/b]
[*]Change it to [b]bEnableOculusSteamVR=True[/b]
[*]Save the file and launch the game again
[*]If your controllers are not working on the Main Menu, the community has mentioned that setting your bindings to default should resolve the issue[/list][/list]

notes.title: Release notes for Hotfix #3 - The Walking Dead Saints & Sinners, CL 158143
notes.content:
[u][b]Additions/Improvements[/b][/u]:[list][*] Physical Crouch (Beta) now on by default![list][*] Crouch with your body or button at any time.[*]Use [b]HMD Reset[/b] at any time to reset your current play stance for Sitting or Standing Play. You can find HMD Reset in the Controller Map for your HMD device.[*]If your height ever feels off, use HMD Reset to correct it.[*] Recent fixes:[list][*] Reduced the radius when checking to avoid many cases of small overhangs causing a full crouch
[*] “Feeling Taller/Shorter” after exiting a crawlspace - Made some adjustments to help maintain consistent height
[*] Improved the camera height change when entering “full crouch” from physical crouch[/list][/list][/list][list][*] Added base 20% deadzone to left motion controller thumbstick axis
[list][*] Make sure to double check your custom deadzone adjustments now that this is in [/list]
[*] Added “Disable All Vignettes” to the Options Menu
[*] Added Option to Adjust the angle on Primary Grip
[*] Added brightness slider in video settings
[*] After placing an item in your Backpack, it should now open to that page
[*] Various Performance optimizations
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]:[list][*] Chaperone should now appear correctly[*]Known Issues: Hybrid seated/standing play mode will sometimes show only the floor outline.[*] Progression break - If the player walked away during the conversation with Man on the Radio during “The Kindness of Strangers” and “When the Levee Breaks…” questlines
[*] Progression break - Fix for Intel cache quest “Tomb and the Tower V”, in Mansion becoming unavailable if you leave without the Intel
[*] Nausea Vignette should now vanish at Zero velocity and/or zero setting
[*] Gunsmith Upgrade properly applies increased damage dealt to enemies
[*] “For Whom the Bell Tolls” Achievement should now unlock properly
[*] “Maybe You’ve Heard of Me” Achievement should now unlock properly
[*] Musical Game Score should no longer play after completing the game
[*] Man on the Radio should no longer call on the radio after completing the game
[*] In some instances NPCs didn’t fire when they should have, now they should, careful!
[*] Fixed an issue with non-ANSI Window usernames, that prevented bindings and other files to not be read correctly
[*] Vive - Fixed Crouch hint to say “Up” instead of “Down”
[*] Various Crash fixes
[/list]

[u][b]Polish[/b][/u]:[list][*]  Some animation and art polish touches[/list]

[u][b]Hacks[/b][/u]:[list][*] More GameUserSettings.ini options you may find  useful:
[list][*]bPhysicalCrouchDisabled = True (if you prefer the old crouch. If you do this, please let us know what's not working for you.)[*]VoiceImmersionThresholdScale (to tune mic pickup level for Voice Immersion.)[*]bMicEnabled = False (to disable all microphone features.  Good for noisy environments and some streamers may prefer this.)[/list][/list]

[u][b]Oh.. and one more thing[/b][/u]:[list][*] Voice Immersion [list][*]There's a menu option to enable it.  Try it.[*]Known issues: Rift, RIftS, Vive, Index supported.  WinMR and 3rd party mic not supported in this build[/list][/list]

notes.title: Release notes for Hotfix #2 - The Walking Dead Saints & Sinners, CL 157393
notes.content:
[b]For everyone:[/b][list]
[*] [b]Handgun/Pistol angle adjustments, two-handed grips on one-handed firearms now stay level[/b][/list]
[b]...and for those who have demanded it:[/b][list]
[*] [b]An Alpha version of Physical Crouching![/b][/list]
This an early Work-in-Progress and there are definitely some flaws, but the early results are so promising we wanted to share it now.  Also, we want to ask your help to make it better. So...

The feature is still in active development, and you'll have to hack the INI to expose it.

Here's how:[list][*] Open your [b]GameUserSettings.ini[/b] file which in typical Windows 10 installs will be here:
[b]C:\\Users\\[i]{username}[/i]\\AppData\\Local\\TWD\\Saved\\Config\\WindowsNoEditor\\GameUserSettings.ini[/b]
[list][*][b]Note[/b]: [i]The AppData folder may be hidden, but you can reveal it via Folder Options from your Start Menu[/i][/list]
[*] FInd the line that reads: 
[b]/Script/TWD.TWDGameUserSettings[/b]
[*] Right below that, insert the following: [b]bPhysicalCrouchEnabled=True[/b]
[*] Run the game, give it a whirl.[/list] 
[b]Some Caveats[/b]:[list][*] Start each play session by hitting [b]ResetHMD/Pause[/b] from a comfortable standing position.  If anything gets weird, do it again.
[*] If you find you have to crouch too far or not far enough you can edit [b]CrouchDistance=32.000[/b] (found in the same file), to any number you find comfortable.  Be sure to post any mods you make that make it feel better.[/list]
[b]Known Flaws[/b]: [list][*]Sometimes pops a bit when entering a crawlspace.  We're already working on it.[*] You can find some bits of level geometry that pop you down when you crawl near them.[/list][/list]
Post about it!  Tell us what's working and what's not, post videos of awkward moments, or of beautiful ones.  Everything we hear helps us make it better, and believe me [u][b]we are listening[/b][/u]!

Last, we want to give a huge shout-out to everyone who pushed us to make this happen.  You were right - it's going to be amazing!  With your help, we'll get it there.
